items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: I went on the bandstand and I knew the musicians. There was Charlie Hatchett that played piano. I got to apologize; I forgot the drummer's name. Charlie Hatchett and the drummer, myself and Cy Jones.

ctx.x: And I got in the car and went over there and just... almost blind with fear. 'Am I crazy for doing this?' I wasn't ready for a job. Cy didn't bother me because I knew musically it wasn't nothing to worry about with Cy. But I really wanted to develop a train and think myself as, I don't know, a musician that's really gonna play some music, not go honking and crawling around on the floor.

And I didn't want to be in that...not what I wanted to get into it for. But, for whatever reason, here I was. I went on the bandstand and I knew the musicians. There was Charlie Hatchett that played piano. I got to apologize; I forgot the drummer's name. Charlie Hatchett and the drummer, myself and Cy Jones.
